about: Maternity terms (one pregnancy: prenatal care, delivery, postpartum care and the hospital stay for the birth) read by hand from each plan's 2027 brochure. pipeline/build_data.py (apply_maternity_terms) applies each entry to data/benefits.json as benefits[code].maternity. A plan is priced only when it has an entry here with a term: OPM's two maternity rows ("Prenatal Care, Screening for Gestational Diabetes, Delivery, and Postpartum Care" and "Hospital Stay--Vaginal Birth, Cesarean Birth") were wrong for about a quarter of the plans checked, so they are never priced unchecked. term: {kind: zero|usd|pct, value, deductible: true|false|null (null = the plan default), per: pregnancy|delivery|admission}; term null = reviewed and left unpriced, with the reason in "unpriced". "sheet" holds the two OPM cells the entry was reviewed against: if either changes, the build stops. Pages are the PDF pages of pipeline/raw/brochures_txt/2027/<brochure>.txt; quotes are verbatim (whitespace collapsed).
